title: Round Crown And Single Pedestal Gymnastics Mushroom
description: One newly authored complete static gymnastics-mushroom-inspired visual prop. A broad low round crowned padded head has a continuous rounded shoulder, finite lower skirt and full underside, carried centrally on one short tapered circular pedestal above a complete wide low beveled circular foot. All three complete closed bodies are newly drawn from different radial profiles. The whole head is circular in plan with a radial crown and no handles, not an old long two-pommel horse with its handles deleted, not the offset directional vaulting-table head, and not a half-dome placed directly on a pierced balance platform. No prior mesh geometry is imported or extracted. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metre units Z up, whole horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. One original model zero scenes, unoccupied fixed display pose only. No gymnast, pommel, mat, text, logo or adjustable mechanism. Category-inspired appearance and game-space proportions only; no exact branded product, official dimensions, training instruction, exercise benefit, user fit, padding response, load, real-world stability, manufacture, installation, use suitability or safety certification. No rigging, animation or interaction.
